purpose: Record the current command package split readiness baseline after fixing generated-project dependency pollution and proving full command package shuffle tests pass.
policy: Do not split command families until command package tests, CLI surface gates, dependency map gates, and candidate-specific golden contracts pass from a clean root module.

releaseBlockerFix.rootCause: GORM and Mongo generated-project dependency updates could find the gofly root go.mod when tests generated models under repository-local temporary directories, which made release check fail the go mod tidy gate later in shuffled test order.
releaseBlockerFix.fix: Generated-project dependency updates now skip the gofly root module and only write to generated project modules or explicit parent modules.

candidateFamilies.reason: The help family has only standard library imports, golden output coverage, and dry-run extraction evidence, but physical movement still needs an output adapter boundary.
requiredPreSplitActions: introduce a package-local output adapter before moving printHelp out of the shared command package
define a small metadata adapter for command registration
prove docs-check still covers every help topic after extraction
candidateFamilies.rollbackRequirement: Restore help files to cmd/gofly/internal/command if help text, usage output, topic routing, or docs synchronization changes.

candidateFamilies.reason: The doctor family has only standard library imports and focused diagnostics, but it still shares JSON/output helpers and must preserve stdout/stderr discipline.
requiredPreSplitActions: pin doctor --json output and nextActions with golden tests
define a package-local adapter for JSON and output helpers
prove support bundle and remediation wording remain stable after extraction
candidateFamilies.rollbackRequirement: Restore doctor files to cmd/gofly/internal/command if diagnostics, JSON fields, stdout, stderr, or support bundle contracts change.

blockedFamilies.reason: AI commands remain too large and depend on core breaker, control-plane, LLM governance, manifest, stream, failover, and project apply helpers.
Shared files still own root command wiring, JSON errors, IO, path flags, IDL helpers, template helpers, compatibility commands, and package-wide tests.

requiredCleanRootSignals: go.mod has no generated-project-only dependency drift after command and generator tests
go.sum has no unexplained generated-project-only checksum drift
release check focused test passes after model generator tests
full cmd/gofly/internal/command shuffle test passes from repository-local temporary caches

nextStep.action: Add doctor family JSON golden output, support-bundle contract coverage, and dry-run extraction evidence before any physical package split.
